text: Majd Investment Company, the investment arm of Almajdouie Group, acquired 25% of Al-Wefaq Company for Transportation Solutions (Yelo) in February 2022; the announcement names Nasser Al-Qahtani as Yelo's chairman.
short: Almajdouie Group's Majd Investment holds 25% of Yelo (Al-Wefaq).

source.name: PR Newswire: Majd Investment acquires 25% of Al-Wefaq Rent a Car Company (Yelo)
source.quote: Majd Investment Company, the investment arm of Almajdouie Group, announced that it has successfully completed the acquisition of 25% of Al-Wefaq Company for Transportation Solutions (Yelo)
